why: The owner's answer of 2026-11-12 (recorded on bead cr-7c6i; plan 40 §11 Q1 (a) and (a)), plan 51 (scratchpad/mvp-stack/51/plan.md): after a contractor result the Phase loop no longer renders and goes straight on, which left the rendered tracking, the Beads export and the stage's .wf/export/<stage>.jsonl uncommitted, so the next contractor call refused a dirty checkout. The order is now the one coordinator stages already used: render where authorized and refresh the Beads export, commit the bookkeeping through land by path, then check git status is clean right before the next contractor call; without commit authority the run keeps the work and stops with a handoff. Item 5 applies the same rule to coordinator writes before any contractor call (a claim, a plan from to-plan, corrected mappings). The workstream walk commits each phase's tracking and export paths through land, and stops at the phase end when the invocation does not cover the commit or forbids it. The Reply's no-commit exit names the phase. No exemption is added to the contractor's dirty guard. Steps diff: implement#6 and implement#8 change only the `when` of their land calls; no step is added or removed.
